components.name: Verdict primary button
components.description: Install action on the verdict field.

narrative.overview: The site reports on the plugin the way a comparative testing magazine reports on a product: a verdict with measured numbers first, the method beside it, rating marks that read without colour, and every figure traceable to its evidence file. Colour lives in the frame; the docs reading column stays calm.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed report voice for headings and labels

rules.name: Colour in the frame, not the column
rules.body: Green owns the verdict field and the masthead rule; body text and docs tables stay ink on paper.

rules.name: State is a mark, not a hue
rules.body: Tier is the count of filled discs; the unchosen arm is dimmed but legible.

dos: Do link every measured number in a results table to its evidence file.
Do show the losing arm of a comparison, dimmed.
donts: Don't add feature-card grids, hero metrics, gradient text or shadows.
Don't put a kicker above a heading.
Don't state a saving the evals do not show.
